statement.text:
A generating system X of a group G is fast if there is an integer n such that
every element of G can be expressed as a product of at most n elements of X or their
inverses. If not, we say that it is slow. For instance, in (Z, +), the squares are fast,
but the powers of 2 are slow.
   Do there exist countable infinite groups without an infinite slow generating set?
Uncountable ones do exist.                                                    B. Poizat
